notes.content:
Hello community!
Update 1.6.0 fixed a bug when saving player progress data.
Good game and enjoy Amazing Maze!
Team Lucky Raccoon Games

notes.title: Big Update 1.5 - New levels and achievements!
notes.content:
Hello!

We are very happy to announce Amazing Maze update 1.5, containing more levels for you to play, as well as new achievements, improvements and fixes. Check out what's new in this version:


 The final chapter has been released, containing 10 more levels for you to play
 It is now possible to record and view your best times (even unofficial times, when you don't collect all the yellow cubes), as well as see which levels you have already completed
 New achievement for completing the final chapter of the game
 We also improved the game's performance and made some fixes for a better gaming experience


I hope you have fun playing Amazing Maze!

Team Lucky Raccoon Games

notes.title: Update 1.2 Details
notes.content:
Hello amazing community!

We are happy to inform you that the Amazing Maze has been updated today with a new chapter for you to play (some levels have already been released since last Saturday in pre-release). Chapter 3 features 10 brand new levels, including new obstacles and challenges, and 3 new achievements.

https://i.postimg.cc/J4hbTs7Q/screenshot-1920x1080-2023-07-15-21-05-12.png

https://i.postimg.cc/xCc6KR3s/screenshot-1920x1080-2023-07-19-11-44-13.png

https://i.postimg.cc/MTNdtQsz/screenshot-1920x1080-2023-07-19-11-47-03.png

The good news is that we will keep updating Amazing Maze and new levels will be added in future updates. Long live the Amazing Maze! :)

As requested by our player community, the new levels are mostly medium/hard difficulties.

If you want to join our Discord community, just click on the following link: Discord Server

Cheers!
Lucky Raccoon Games Team

notes.title: Update 1.0.3
notes.content:
This update has improved some aspects of the game, such as level signage and the level selection and leaderboard menus:

- Our team of raccoons went into some levels today with bucket of paint and brush in hand to place signs in some levels (hopefully you haven't seen them around). They added lots of arrows, danger alerts and new parkour markings. It was really hard work!

- We've also added images for each of the levels in the level select and leaderboards menus, so that you can more easily identify which level is currently selected.

We hope you have fun playing Amazing Maze!

notes.title: Update 1.0.2
notes.content:
This small update fixed some bugs:

- There was a random bug in level 3 that prevented players from progressing in the game, since the laser wouldn't turn off. We already got the toolbox, tightened some screws and now it will behave as it should from now on.

- The leaderboard screen was fetching more results than it should and this caused an overflow in the rankings view. That too has been fixed and now everything will work fine.

notes.title: Demo Update 0.3.3
notes.content:
We're back with another update for the Amazing Maze. This will be the last update before the full game launches on May 1st.

We collected a lot of really nice feedback that added a lot to what we had planned so far for the final version. Look forward to even more improvements and challenging levels!

Save the date: May 1st!

Don't forget to add Amazing Maze to your wishlist to be notified of the launch discount :)

What's new in this update:

- We've added support for camera rotation, so you can better utilize the climbing skill and see levels from new and different perspectives
- We've added a bird's eye view camera so you can see what's coming up in the levels, as well as see the more "hidden" yellow cubes
- We have included in the UI a list of all game play commands, whenever you start Amazing Maze and play the first level

We hope you enjoyed this update!
Lucky Raccoon Games Team

notes.title: Demo Update 0.3.2
notes.content:
Many thanks to all the thousands of players around the world who have downloaded the Amazing Maze demo and sent feedback to our team. (If you haven't sent your opinion yet, you can do so by clicking here)

We've made a few more improvements to the Amazing Maze based on top community-rated items:

- Added magnetism to the finish line hole, pulling the sphere inwards when passing over it
- We reduced the wait time during the activation of a special ability
- We also made some more tweaks and fixes to give you an even better and faster experience

We are waiting for you and hope you enjoyed this update!
Lucky Raccoon Games Team

notes.title: Demo Update 0.3.1 + New Level
notes.content:
First of all, we would like to say that we are very happy for the thousands of people who downloaded the Amazing Maze demo in just 2 days of launch. For us this has been an incredible experience and we are very grateful for all the support we have received so far.

We made a small update to the demo today, check out what's new below:

1. Fixed a small overflow bug on the leaderboard.

2. In appreciation of the huge support we've received from the community, we've also released one more level for you to play (level 4).

3. We've added an optional anonymous data collection (you can opt-out in the options menu). This collection refers only to the use of the demo, for example, so that our team understands which levels are preferred by the community, which they started and which they managed to complete. This will guide our team through the final stretch of development until the game launches on May 1st.

Oh! Be sure to add Amazing Maze to your wishlist to be notified on launch day and take advantage of the amazing launch discount we're preparing for you!

Thanks again and have fun with the Amazing Maze!
